question.prompt: If the polynomial \(x^2 y^{|m|}-3x+1\) is a trinomial of degree 3, find the value of \(m\). (If there are multiple answers, separate them with commas.)

solutions.explanation: The degree of the highest-degree term \(x^2 y^{|m|}\) is \(2+|m|\). From \(2+|m|=3\), we obtain \(|m|=1\), so \(m=1\) or \(m=-1\).
solutions.title: Degree condition and absolute value
